has_interface_abstraction.classification_policy: Requires an explicitly platform/version/architecture-named adapter or strategy declaration, a current-head implementation, and an actual platform, SDK/version, ABI, or non-compatible API call inside that implementation. Only a status actually covered by such a call receives the abstraction cap; UI callbacks, providers, names alone, and arbitrary abstract classes do not qualify.
